description: Eolien terrestre - Postes de livraison des parcs éoliens en Pays de la Loire (OREOL) is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SIGLOIRE. Le poste de livraison est le nœud de raccordement de toutes les éoliennes avant que l’électricité ne soit injectée dans le réseau public. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are TEO, Energie-Climat, Eolien terrestre, Production EnR, pays de la loire. The portal shows 231 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
